body.statement: For every fixed \(\delta>0\), \(\sup_{\mathbf P\in\mathfrak M(\delta)}\Pr_{\mathbb P_n}\{\exists j\in\mathcal J\setminus\mathcal C_n:I_{j,n}(\alpha)\ne\varnothing\}\to0\), and \(\lim_{\xi\to\infty}\limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{\mathbf P\in\mathfrak M(\delta)}\Pr_{\mathbb P_n}\{\sqrt n\operatorname{diam}(C_n^{\mathrm{proj}}(\alpha))>\xi\}=0\).
body.justification: Honesty near label collisions is useful only if the method recovers ordinary root-sample precision when donors are separated.
body.gap: Projection methods are known to be conservative, but the exact fixed-separation recovery statement for zero-score donor labels is not supplied by the general post-selection literature.
body.consumer: Applications with one clearly matching comparison state pay no first-order diameter penalty for guarding against weak separation.
